新增世界規則控制 Observer 開啟／關閉、好友觀察權限及是否允許非旁觀模式開始觀察。結束觀察時恢復原本模式與位置。新增 Nexus 管理權限畫面 provider 缺席時的 metadata-only 測試。

World rules control Observer availability, friend access and starting observation from any game mode. Ending observation restores the original mode and position. Includes metadata-only fallback coverage when the Nexus access provider is absent.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric / Java 25. Requires Fabric API and TotemCore >=0.7.18 <0.8.0. Use TotemVanillaTweaks 0.1.28 or newer when installed together. Project moderation remains separate from version upload.
